purpose: Test whether the four committed project SWC coordinates directly reproduce the four recorded Point_data root coordinates under nm-to-um division by 1000.

published_generator_context.operation: convert Reduced_dendrites from nm to um, then tree.get_root_coordinate()
published_generator_context.upstream: PP3 creates Reduced_dendrites through subtree extraction and forest reduction

proven: The committed SWCs do not reproduce the recorded Point_data roots by simply dividing their raw parent=-1 coordinates by 1000.
The residuals are hundreds of micrometres, not rounding noise.
not_proven: This does not disprove historical Point_data provenance because the documented generator consumes Reduced_dendrites, while the exact December 2025 intermediate trees are unavailable.
It does not establish a coordinate transform or alternate source.
interpretation.next_target: Recover the historical Reduced_dendrite trees or another intermediate artifact containing their root coordinates, then compare directly to Point_data.
